review_summary: Comprehensive Review (Chidzidzo 7) consolidates Lessons 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. Key structures mastered in this block include Zezuru alliterative subject/object concords (zvivakashure), agglutinative tense/aspect markers (-no- habitual, -ka- past, -cha- future), and high/low tone patterns across: 2nd Person Plural Imperative Suffix (-i); Mupanda 17 Proximal Locative (kuno); Associative + Mupanda 15 Infinitive (neku-); 1st Person Plural Past Concord (taka-). Example utterances reviewed: "Huyai kuno nekukasira!" | "Takatenga hupfu, shuga, mafuta, nemuriwo." | "Akadanidzira achiti, "Batai mbavha iyo!""

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Huyai kuno ______!' (Come here quickly!)
review_exercises.explanation: 'nekukasira' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Takatenga hupfu, shuga, mafuta, ______.' (We bought maize meal, sugar, cooking oil, and vegetables.)
review_exercises.explanation: 'nemuriwo' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Akadanidzira achiti, "Batai mbavha ______!"' (He shouted saying, "Catch that thief!")
review_exercises.explanation: 'iyo' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Amai vakati, "Chiuya kuno ______."' (Mother said, "Come here now and help me.")
review_exercises.explanation: 'undibatsire' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Unofunga kuti mvura ichanaya here ______?' (Do you think it will rain tomorrow?)
review_exercises.explanation: 'mangwana' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Vakuru vanoti, "Chara chimwe hachitswanyi ______."' (The elders say, "One finger cannot crush a louse.")
review_exercises.explanation: 'inda' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.
